project can use Linear as its one tracker: register a Linear API key, bind a default team, and adopt or link Linear issues the way Jira cards are adopted today\u0022,\u0022AcceptanceCriteria\u0022:[\u0022Before any other criterion is built, a live Linear workspace check records three facts in the PR description: whether the issue assignee is single-valued, whether issue(id:) still resolves an identifier after the issue moves to another team, and whether attachmentCreate links a URL idempotently; the stored reference format (identifier or UUID) follows from the second\u0022,\u0022h9k connection add linear --api-key \\u003Cenv:|keychain:|file: reference\\u003E probes Linear\\u0027s viewer query, refuses a rejected key with the remedy, and records the viewer\\u0027s id and name on the connection; the key itself is never stored\u0022,\u0022One Linear connection per install, refused on a second exactly as Jira\\u0027s is\u0022,\u0022h9k project set \\u003Cproject\\u003E --linear \\u003CTEAM\\u003E binds a default team for new issues; \\u0027none\\u0027 clears it\u0022,\u0022A project has at most one tracker (none, GitHub issues, Jira, or Linear): binding Linear on a project with another tracker set is refused, naming the current one, and a task on a Linear project is refused a --from-jira or --from-issue link, naming the project\\u0027s tracker\u0022,\u0022Changing a project\\u0027s tracker later stays possible: existing task links keep their provider and remain readable and closable as history, and only new links must match the new tracker\u0022,\u0022h9k task add --from-linear \\u003Cidentifier or URL\\u003E and h9k task link-linear \\u003Ctask\\u003E \\u003Cidentifier\\u003E read the issue through Linear\\u0027s API, accept an issue from any team the key can see (no bound-team check), and record it as linear:\\u003Cidentifier\\u003E\u0022,\u0022Adoption maps Linear state types: backlog, unstarted, and started adopt; completed, canceled, and duplicate are refused; triage is refused with a pointer to h9k idea add --from-linear\u0022,\u0022An HTTP 200 response carrying a GraphQL errors array is treated as a failure, and a 429 RATELIMITED response maps to an outage with its Retry-After\u0022,\u0022h9k doctor probes the Linear connection when a project\\u0027s tracker is Linear, distinguishing no connection from a rejected key\u0022,\u0022h9k task show renders a Linear link as the issue\\u0027s web URL\u0022],\u0022Type\u0022:\u0022Feature\u0022,\u0022AgentContext\u0022:\u0022A Linear connector, so a project whose work and backlog live in Linear gets the same tracker integration hall9k gives
